newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland invites bids for Dromex road builder.
newsitem.headline: Poland invites bids for Dromex road builder.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry is inviting bids for a stake of not less than 10 percent in construction firm Dromex SA, the ministry said on Tuesday.
It said in a newspaper advertisement that investors had until January 17 to place bids.
It said that under Polish law employees would receive 15 percent of the company's shares free of charge and that five percent would go to restitution claims.

Dromex, which specialises in infrastructure projects such as roads and bridges, is part of the Autostrady SA consortium that is seeking to build a 364-kilometre motorway between the central city of Lodz and the German border.
